campaign.name: RefillLoop: Make the refill routine easier to repeat
campaign.classification: Fictional proposed campaign; no product launch, performance, customer, or environmental claim.
product_assumptions: RefillLoop is a proposed modular reusable hydration system with replaceable carry components.
A proposed companion experience supplies optional routine prompts; no health, scientific, or impact benefit is claimed.
Illustrative early-access price hypothesis: USD 44–64; validate willingness to pay before a real launch.
campaign.positioning: A proposed routine-design system for people whose hydration needs shift across commute, desk, training, and travel—not a claim of market leadership.

personas.name: Maya — hybrid commuter
personas.motivation: Reduce carry friction across changing locations
personas.pain_point: Forgets or abandons routines when plans change
personas.targeting: Interest/context test: commuting, hybrid work, productivity; exclude unsupported demographic inference.

personas.name: Sam — active routine builder
personas.pain_point: Needs simple cues and portable organization
personas.targeting: Interest/context test: training routines, wellbeing content, reusable products; test creative, do not assume conversion.

personas.name: Aisha — workplace wellbeing lead
personas.motivation: Offer low-friction routine prompts for hybrid teams
personas.targeting: LinkedIn job-function/context test: people operations, workplace experience, facilities; use platform policy-compliant targeting only.

objectives.smart_target: Over 30 days, deliver 120,000 proposed paid-and-organic impressions while recording platform-native reach separately.
objectives.baseline_assumption: No prior audience or account baseline is available.
objectives.measurement: Platform reach exports and UTM-tagged landing-page sessions.

objectives.smart_target: Run at least four planned A/B creative or CTA comparisons and retain a decision log by Day 30.
objectives.baseline_assumption: No prior creative winner is assumed.
objectives.measurement: Predefined primary KPI per test; do not call a winner without adequate delivery and context.

objectives.smart_target: Model 30 base-scenario qualified interest-form completions over 30 days; report 300 only as a stretch scenario with separate traffic conditions.
objectives.baseline_assumption: Base scenario uses 120,000 impressions, 1.0% assumed CTR, and 2.5% assumed form completion; not a forecast.
objectives.measurement: Consent-aware form-completion event and source UTM.

budget.assumption: Illustrative media-only planning budget; no spend is authorized or incurred.

Instagram.geography: Proposed initial test market: Karachi metropolitan area; rationale: one defined urban test area makes creative learning easier to interpret. This is not evidence of demand.
Instagram.language: English creative; review Urdu adaptation for comprehension and platform capability before launch.
Instagram.age: Proposed 23–40 where available; verify current platform controls.
Instagram.inclusion: Policy-compliant interest/context tests around commuting, hybrid work, productivity, fitness routines, and reusable products; verify availability before use.
Instagram.exclusion: Exclude existing interest-form completers from conversion retargeting where a lawful consent-aware audience is available; do not infer sensitive traits.
Instagram.placement: Reels, Stories, and Feed tested separately; retain placement-level reporting.
Instagram.conversion_event: Consent-aware early-interest form completion or qualified concept-page visit.
Instagram.privacy_policy: Use platform-approved controls only; verify options and privacy requirements before a live campaign.

LinkedIn.geography: Proposed initial test market: Karachi metropolitan area; use a single professional-context test area for interpretable learning.
LinkedIn.language: English professional copy; review Urdu adaptation separately if supported and appropriate.
LinkedIn.age: No age-based professional targeting is proposed; use platform-approved professional context only.
LinkedIn.inclusion: Verify current targeting for people operations, workplace experience, facilities, and operations functions; use role/function contexts, not sensitive inferences.
LinkedIn.exclusion: Exclude current employees and completed interest-form audiences only where lawful, consented, and supported by the platform.
LinkedIn.placement: Feed and document/article formats; compare sponsored document with text-post treatment.
LinkedIn.conversion_event: Qualified toolkit download or consent-aware early-interest form completion.
LinkedIn.privacy_policy: Platform controls and minimum-audience rules must be verified before launch.

YouTube.geography: Proposed initial test market: Karachi metropolitan area; separate geographic expansion from the first creative test.
YouTube.language: English spoken/captioned creative; review Urdu captions or alternate creative before use.
YouTube.age: Proposed adult audience only where age controls are available and policy-compliant; verify current options.
YouTube.inclusion: Contextual tests around commuting organization, workplace productivity, fitness routines, and reusable-product education; verify placement controls.
YouTube.exclusion: Exclude made-for-children content and unsuitable placements using current documented controls; do not profile sensitive audiences.
YouTube.placement: Shorts for discovery; skippable long-form/contextual inventory for demonstrations; report format separately.
YouTube.conversion_event: Qualified concept-page session or consent-aware early-interest form completion.
YouTube.privacy_policy: Verify current YouTube/Google Ads targeting, placement, and consent requirements before launch.

funnel.formula: interest completions = impressions × click-through rate × landing-form completion rate

scenarios.name: Stretch
scenarios.classification: not a primary target; requires 6,000 sessions and materially stronger traffic conditions or additional authorized reach

ab_tests.hypothesis: A routine-friction hook earns more qualified concept clicks than a general product-reveal hook.
ab_tests.decision_criterion: Pre-agree a minimum delivery threshold; retain the variant with the stronger primary metric and document context.

ab_tests.hypothesis: A LinkedIn document explaining implementation earns more qualified clicks than a professional text post.
ab_tests.decision_criterion: Compare only after equivalent planned delivery conditions; record no winner if evidence is insufficient.

ab_tests.hypothesis: A workplace-toolkit video opening sustains more qualified attention than a feature-led opening.
ab_tests.primary_metric: Average view duration and end-screen click-through rate
ab_tests.decision_criterion: Use a pre-agreed attention threshold and report both measures, not views alone.

ab_tests.hypothesis: ‘Choose your path’ creates more qualified interest than ‘request early access’ for undecided routine seekers.
ab_tests.audience: IG-KHI-01 / Maya and Sam retargeting only if lawful and consent-aware
ab_tests.decision_criterion: Require comparable landing experience and documented delivery before deciding.
